description: This file defines the 'XImage' class within the 'PdfSharp.Drawing' namespace, which is an abstract representation for image objects (bitmaps, PDFs, etc.) used in PDFSharp. It includes multiple constructors for various image source types (GDI+, WPF, URI, stream, file). It also contains properties for image dimensions, resolution, format detection (JPEG, PNG, GIF, etc.), and methods for loading and managing images, along with internal helper methods and platform-specific code. The class manages underlying image resources and their lifecycle, supporting platform-specific image formats and detection mechanisms.

classes.name: XImage
classes.description: Represents an image that can be drawn in a PDF, supporting various image sources (file, stream, GDI+, WPF, etc.) and formats. Provides properties for size, resolution, format detection, and resource management. Acts as an abstraction layer for images in the PDFSharp library, with platform-specific implementations and utilities.

methods.name: FromFile
methods.description: Creates an XImage instance from a specified file path, detecting if the file is a PDF. Supports various formats and platform-specific constructors.

methods.name: FromStream
methods.description: Creates an XImage instance from a stream containing image data or a PDF, with support for seekable and non-seekable streams (GDI only).

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of GDI and WPF image resources and marks the image as disposed.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes internal properties like image format based on the underlying image source.
